lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, Sunrise Clinic. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi. I'd like to see a skin doctor this week, if possible.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Of course. Doctor Shrestha sees skin patients on Wednesday and Friday mornings. Wednesday at ten thirty is free. Would that work?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Done. Can I have your name, please?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you, Sita. You're booked with Doctor Shrestha on Wednesday at ten thirty. I'll send the details to this number by SMS.
